content.text:
I've finished and submitted **index 29** (Mg 0.19 / Sb 0.81) as the best composition, with an EQE of **0.087%**. I used all 3 merit measurements. I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phases in these films were never identified.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 18 | 0.49 | 0.0008 |
| 24 | 0.66 | 0.014 |
| 29 | 0.81 | 0.087 |

- **Trend:** EQE rises sharply as Sb increases. Sb oxides are the phases most likely to absorb light at the 3.2 eV used here.
- **Uncertainty:** Index 29 is the most Sb-rich composition in the library, so the true peak could sit right at that edge or a little before it. I didn't measure the neighbours (indices 27 and 28) to check. The third measurement went to a mid-range composition instead, to look for a separate high point there, and it came out close to zero.
- **Mg-rich end (indices 0–17):** Not measured. The model-based suggestion tool pointed to index 0 only because that side had no data, not because it predicted a high value. Mg-rich films should be mostly MgO, which barely absorbs at this energy, and the measured trend falls as Mg increases.
